subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A letter, poem etc. whose author is unknown.
solution:
The correct answer is **Anonymous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **appropriate **one-word substitution for '**A letter, poem, etc. whose author is unknown**' is '**Anonymous**'.
 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• ​**Autonomous**- having the right or power of self-government.
 
• **Anomalous**- different from what is normal.
 
• **Autocrat**- a person who expects to be obeyed by other people and does not care about their opinions or feelings.
